```sql
SELECT
    pmb.batter,
    SUM(pmb.runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(pmb.fours) * 4 + SUM(pmb.sixes) * 6 AS boundary_runs,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (SUM(pmb.fours) * 4 + SUM(pmb.sixes) * 6) /
        NULLIF(SUM(pmb.runs), 0),
        2
    ) AS boundary_share_percent
FROM player_match_batting pmb
GROUP BY pmb.batter
HAVING SUM(pmb.runs) >= 1000
ORDER BY (SUM(pmb.fours) * 4 + SUM(pmb.sixes) * 6)::numeric / SUM(pmb.runs) DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
